title: manilkara balata var. cruegeri
intro: Manilkara balata var. cruegeri, commonly known as the Jamaican dogwood, is a plant species within the Sapotaceae family. It is traditionally used for its potential health benefits, including the relief of anxiety, insomnia, and pain, which are attributed to its therapeutic actions such as sedation, antispasmodic, and anti-inflammatory properties. The bioactive constituents present in the plant include alkaloids, glycosides, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties. Additionally, the plant has been used to treat various health conditions, including fever, cough, and diarrhea, although further research is needed to confirm its efficacy.
